column5: The NIST heading names Fe-9.0Ni and also prints UNS S21800. This pack identifies only the named Fe-9.0Ni source family and preserves that printed label as unresolved source metadata, not an independently qualified alloy code. NIST cites the LNG Materials and Fluids compilation for all four properties but does not establish common coupons. Heat capacity starts at the 60 K data limit, rather than the 55 K equation limit. Finite expansion ends at the 265 K equation limit despite the nominal L293 denominator and data extending to 300 K; no evaluation at 293 K is licensed. The selected specific heat retains the source name, without an inferred Cp-to-Cv conversion. Engineering-reference-model=1 explicitly accepts compiled source fits and authored linear interpolation. Product form, complete processing, pressure, orientation and matched specimens remain unknown unless named. Scalar conductivity does not establish isotropy. No density, phase-change, loss, fracture or strength law is added.
